data.gender_notes: Stephanie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Stephaneos, meaning ‘crown’, or ‘garland of flowers’. In the New Testament, Saint Stephen, the first Christian martyr, was given the name Stephanos, or ‘crowned one’. The name Stephanie carries the meaning “Crown of flowers” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Stephanie usually hope their child will grow to embody crown of flowers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
